import sand3d as s3d
import random
import numpy as np


def peace_lily(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(6, smooth=False)
    pot = terracotta_pot(seed=seed+1)
    soil = s3d.at(soil_surface(seed=seed+2), on=pot.planting)
    clump = s3d.at(basal_clump(seed=seed+3), on=soil.face('top'))
    sites = s3d.ring(11, 14, start=7, on=s3d.local(clump, z=5)).jitter(rz=13, seed=seed+4)
    foliage = []
    stages = [(80,135,225,78,8,35),(48,230,220,76,44,30),(96,120,210,83,-12,35),(48,270,195,67,54,22),(83,155,235,86,15,38),(60,235,220,75,40,34),(100,113,215,80,-15,32),(48,280,195,68,53,25),(87,155,220,83,12,36),(64,215,230,80,35,34),(92,123,220,85,-5,32)]
    for i, (site, dims) in enumerate(zip(sites, stages)):
        site = site.turn(rz=i*360/len(sites))
        spread, rise, length, width, lift, droop = dims
        petiole = s3d.at(leaf_petiole(spread=spread, rise=rise, seed=seed+100+i), on=site)
        blade = s3d.at(folded_leaf_blade(length=length, width=width, droop=droop, seed=seed+200+i), on=s3d.local(petiole, y=spread, z=rise, rx=lift))
        foliage.extend([petiole, blade])
    flowers = []
    flower_sites = s3d.ring(3, 19, start=25, on=s3d.local(clump, z=3)).jitter(rz=9, seed=seed+5)
    flower_stages = [(48,438,126,72,15),(72,397,115,68,45),(38,466,127,72,5)]
    for i, (site, dims) in enumerate(zip(flower_sites, flower_stages)):
        site = site.turn(rz=i*360/len(flower_sites))
        spread, rise, height, width, turn = dims
        stalk = s3d.at(flower_stalk(spread=spread, rise=rise, seed=seed+300+i), on=site)
        hood = s3d.at(ivory_spathe(height=height, width=width, seed=seed+400+i), on=s3d.local(stalk, y=spread, z=rise, rz=turn-i*360/len(flower_sites)))
        spadix = s3d.at(pale_yellow_spadix(seed=seed+500+i), on=s3d.local(hood, y=-5, z=8))
        flowers.extend([stalk, hood, spadix])
    return s3d.assembly('peace_lily', pot, soil, clump, *foliage, *flowers)


def terracotta_pot(d=184, base_d=130, height=170, wall=8, lip_h=18, lip_overhang=7, seed=0):
    body_h = height-lip_h/2
    body = s3d.shell(s3d.cone('tapered_clay_pot', base_d, body_h, d2=d), wall, open='top')
    s3d.material(body, 'ceramic', color='#ad573a', roughness=0.95)
    rim = s3d.at(s3d.tube('thick_clay_lip', d+2*lip_overhang, d-2*wall, lip_h), z=height-lip_h)
    s3d.material(rim, 'ceramic', color='#c46b46', roughness=0.95)
    return s3d.assembly('terracotta_pot', body, rim, planting=s3d.Frame((0,0,height-lip_h)))


def soil_surface(d=163, h=5, seed=0):
    soil = s3d.cylinder('dark_potting_soil', d, h)
    s3d.material(soil, 'soil', color='#30271d')
    return soil


def basal_clump(d=32, h=23, seed=0):
    core = s3d.cone('dense_green_crown', d, h, d2=d/2)
    s3d.material(core, 'leaf', color='#285c28', roughness=0.8)
    return core


def leaf_petiole(spread=70, rise=210, diameter=4.5, seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    bend = rng.uniform(-9,9)
    path = [(0,0,0), (bend,spread*.22,rise*.48), (bend/2,spread*.60,rise*.81), (0,spread,rise)]
    stem = s3d.wire('leaf_petiole', path, [(0,diameter),(1,diameter*.64)])
    s3d.material(stem, 'leaf', color='#397c37', roughness=0.72)
    return s3d.assembly('petiole', stem, tip=s3d.Frame((0,spread,rise)))


def folded_leaf_blade(length=220, width=80, droop=34, fold=0.13, thickness=0.8, seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Authored normalized lance outline: narrow shoulders, broad belly, tapering tip.
    rows = [(0,0),(.18,.67),(.43,1),(.72,.77),(1,0)]
    sections = []
    # The margins vary by seven percent; the small asymmetric edge rise accents the central fold.
    edge_variation, sway, edge_rise = .07, .04, .03
    for u, breadth in rows:
        center = width*sway*np.sin(np.pi*u)*rng.uniform(-1,1)
        half = width*breadth/2
        z = -droop*u*u + length*sway*np.sin(np.pi*u)
        left = (center-half*rng.uniform(1-edge_variation,1+edge_variation), length*u, z)
        mid = (center, length*u, z+width*fold*breadth)
        right = (center+half*rng.uniform(1-edge_variation,1+edge_variation), length*u, z+width*edge_rise*breadth)
        sections.append([left,mid,right])
    panels = []
    for j in range(len(sections)-1):
        for k in range(2):
            corners = [sections[j][k],sections[j][k+1],sections[j+1][k],sections[j+1][k+1]]
            panels.append(folded_panel('leaf_facet',corners,thickness))
    blade = s3d.merge(*panels)
    tone = rng.uniform(.92,1.05)
    def leaf_color(x,y,z):
        pale = np.array([.13,.43,.19])*tone
        dark = np.array([.025,.17,.075])*tone
        return np.where((x>0)[:,None],pale,dark)
    s3d.material(blade, 'leaf', color=leaf_color, roughness=.76)
    return blade


def folded_panel(name, corners, thickness):
    points = corners + [(x,y,z-thickness) for x,y,z in corners]
    return s3d.hull(name, points)


def flower_stalk(spread=40, rise=440, diameter=5.5, seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    sway = rng.uniform(-12,12)
    path = [(0,0,0),(sway,spread*.25,rise*.43),(sway/2,spread*.83,rise*.79),(0,spread,rise)]
    stalk = s3d.wire('flower_stalk',path,[(0,diameter),(1,diameter*.66)])
    s3d.material(stalk, 'leaf', color='#51883a', roughness=.75)
    return s3d.assembly('flower_stalk',stalk,tip=s3d.Frame((0,spread,rise)))


def ivory_spathe(height=125, width=67, cup=21, thickness=1.2, seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    lean = rng.uniform(-8,8)
    rows = [(0,.08),(.22,.72),(.5,1),(.77,.68),(1,0)]
    sections = []
    for u, breadth in rows:
        center = lean*u*u
        edge_y = -cup*.55*breadth-cup*.3*u*u
        back_y = cup*breadth-cup*.3*u*u
        sections.append([(center-width*breadth/2,edge_y,height*u),(center,back_y,height*u),(center+width*breadth/2,edge_y,height*u)])
    panels = []
    for j in range(len(sections)-1):
        for k in range(2):
            corners = [sections[j][k],sections[j][k+1],sections[j+1][k],sections[j+1][k+1]]
            panels.append(folded_panel('ivory_spathe_facet',corners,thickness))
    hood = s3d.merge(*panels)
    s3d.material(hood,'ceramic',color='#bdbdad',roughness=.9)
    return s3d.assembly('ivory_spathe',hood,throat=s3d.Frame((0,-5,8)))


def pale_yellow_spadix(height=65, diameter=10, seed=0):
    body = s3d.loft('pale_yellow_spadix',s3d.station(0,diameter*.8,diameter*.8),s3d.station(height*.2,diameter,diameter),s3d.station(height*.85,diameter*.88,diameter*.88),s3d.station(height,diameter*.5,diameter*.5))
    s3d.material(body,'leaf',color='#c5a447',roughness=.9)
    return body

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random

def toy_calathea(seed=0, pot_turn=22.5, soil_drop=15):
    pot = s3d.at(terracotta_pot(seed=seed + 1), rz=pot_turn)
    soil = s3d.at(planting_soil(seed=seed + 2), on=s3d.bbox(pot, '+Z').offset(-soil_drop), rz=pot_turn)
    layout = growth_layout(seed=seed + 3)
    stems = s3d.at(petiole_cluster(layout, seed=seed + 4), on=s3d.local(soil, z=8, rz=-pot_turn))
    leaves = s3d.at(folded_leaf_blades(layout, seed=seed + 5), on=s3d.local(soil, z=8, rz=-pot_turn))
    return s3d.assembly('toy_calathea', pot, soil, stems, leaves)

def terracotta_pot(seed=0, height=118, base_d=185, mouth_d=225, wall=12, lip=8, rim_h=18):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    radius = mouth_d / 2
    profile = [(0, 0), (base_d / 2, 0), (radius, height - rim_h), (radius + lip, height - rim_h), (radius + lip, height), (radius - wall, height), (base_d / 2 - wall, wall), (0, wall)]
    pot = s3d.revolve('angular_terracotta_pot', s3d.poly(profile))
    s3d.material(pot, 'ceramic', color='#b96548', roughness=0.95)
    return pot

def planting_soil(seed=0, diameter=198, depth=8):
    soil = s3d.cylinder('recessed_dark_soil', diameter, depth)
    s3d.material(soil, 'soil', color='#382b29', roughness=1)
    return soil

def growth_layout(seed=0, outer_count=8, inner_count=3, root_radius=19, outer_reach=86, inner_reach=29):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    sites = list(s3d.ring(outer_count, root_radius, start=12)) + list(s3d.ring(inner_count, root_radius / 2, start=72))
    layout = []
    for i, site in enumerate(sites):
        inner = i >= outer_count
        radial = np.array([site.origin.x, site.origin.y, 0.0])
        radial = radial / np.linalg.norm(radial)
        reach = (inner_reach if inner else outer_reach) * rng.uniform(0.8, 1.16)
        height = rng.uniform(285, 325) if inner else rng.uniform(150, 250)
        endpoint = radial * reach + np.array([0.0, 0.0, height])
        base = np.array([site.origin.x, site.origin.y, -3.0])
        elbow = base * 0.5 + endpoint * 0.5
        elbow[:2] *= 0.68
        path = [tuple(base), tuple(elbow), tuple(endpoint)]
        tip = s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1]
        rise = rng.uniform(0.95, 1.35) if inner else rng.uniform(0.24, 0.72)
        direction = (radial[0], radial[1], rise)
        roll = 110 if i == outer_count - 2 else rng.uniform(-32, 32)
        frame = s3d.Frame(origin=tip.origin, normal=direction, up=(-0.65, 0.65, -1)).turn(rz=roll)
        length = rng.uniform(173, 203) if inner else rng.uniform(157, 193)
        width = length * rng.uniform(0.57, 0.65)
        layout.append((path, frame, length, width))
    return layout

def petiole_cluster(layout, seed=0, diameter=4.8):
    stems = []
    diameters = s3d.vary(diameter, 0.65, len(layout), seed=seed + 1)
    for i, ((path, frame, length, width), d) in enumerate(zip(layout, diameters)):
        stem = s3d.wire('green_petiole_%02d' % i, path, d=d, fillet=18)
        s3d.material(stem, 'leaf', color='#277346', roughness=0.9)
        stems.append(stem)
    return s3d.group('petiole_cluster', *stems)

def folded_leaf_blades(layout, seed=0):
    leaves = []
    for i, (path, frame, length, width) in enumerate(layout):
        leaf = folded_leaf(length=length, width=width, seed=seed + 100 + i, glow=i >= len(layout) - 3)
        leaves.append(s3d.at(leaf, on=frame))
    return s3d.group('folded_leaf_blades', *leaves)

def folded_leaf(seed=0, length=185, width=95, fold_ratio=0.16, thickness=1.7, glow=False):
    sections = leaf_stations(length, width)
    pieces = []
    for (za, wa), (zb, wb) in zip(sections[:-1], sections[1:]):
        for side in (-1, 1):
            top = [(0, -fold_ratio * wa, za), (side * wa, 0, za), (side * wb, 0, zb), (0, -fold_ratio * wb, zb)]
            bottom = [(x, y + thickness, z) for x, y, z in top]
            pieces.append(s3d.hull('folded_lamina_panel', top + bottom))
    blade = s3d.merge(*pieces)

    def blade_color(x, y, z, n):
        upper = n[1] < 0
        return np.where(upper[:, None], np.array([0.035, 0.265, 0.145]), np.array([0.3, 0.105, 0.18]))
    s3d.material(blade, 'leaf', color=blade_color, roughness=0.94)
    markings = mint_feather_bands(sections, fold_ratio, length, width, seed=seed + 1)
    accents = luminous_vein_accents(sections, fold_ratio, length, width, seed=seed + 2, luminous=glow)
    return s3d.group('pointed_folded_leaf', blade, markings, accents)

def leaf_stations(length, width):
    proportions = [(0, 0.025), (0.16, 0.61), (0.38, 0.97), (0.61, 1), (0.81, 0.69), (0.96, 0.22), (1, 0.012)]
    return [(u * length, w * width / 2) for u, w in proportions]

def mint_feather_bands(sections, fold_ratio, length, width, seed=0, pairs=6, start_u=0.17, pitch_u=0.11, sweep_u=0.12, reach_ratio=0.88, band_ratio=0.02):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    bands = []
    for k in range(pairs):
        u = start_u + k * pitch_u
        for side in (-1, 1):
            start = (u + rng.uniform(-0.01, 0.01)) * length
            end = min(start + length * sweep_u, length * 0.91)
            reach = float(np.interp(end, np.array(sections)[:, 0], np.array(sections)[:, 1])) * reach_ratio
            band_w = length * band_ratio
            root = side * width * 0.01
            elbow = side * reach / 2
            bend_z = start + band_w
            outline = [(root, start), (elbow, bend_z), (side * reach, end), (elbow, bend_z + band_w), (root, start + band_w)]
            bands.append(raised_leaf_band('mint_feather', outline, sections, fold_ratio))
    markings = s3d.merge(*bands)
    s3d.material(markings, 'leaf', color='#729b82', roughness=0.95)
    return markings

def raised_leaf_band(name, outline, sections, fold_ratio, lift=0.38, thickness=0.45):
    chunks = []
    for (low, wa), (high, wb) in zip(sections[:-1], sections[1:]):
        polygon = clip_band(clip_band(outline, low, True), high, False)
        if len(polygon) < 3:
            continue
        top = [(x, leaf_height(x, z, sections, fold_ratio) - lift, z) for x, z in polygon]
        bottom = [(x, y + thickness, z) for x, y, z in top]
        chunks.append(s3d.hull(name, top + bottom))
    return s3d.merge(*chunks)

def clip_band(points, level, keep_above):
    result = []
    for a, b in zip(points, points[1:] + points[:1]):
        ina = a[1] >= level if keep_above else a[1] <= level
        inb = b[1] >= level if keep_above else b[1] <= level
        if ina:
            result.append(a)
        if ina != inb:
            t = (level - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1])
            result.append((a[0] + t * (b[0] - a[0]), level))
    return result

def leaf_height(x, z, sections, fold_ratio):
    stations = np.array(sections)
    half_width = float(np.interp(z, stations[:, 0], stations[:, 1]))
    return -fold_ratio * (half_width - abs(x))

def luminous_vein_accents(sections, fold_ratio, length, width, seed=0, luminous=True, vein_width=4.2):
    parts = []
    for side in (-1, 1):
        outline = [(0, length * 0.035), (side * vein_width / 2, length * 0.14), (side * vein_width / 2, length * 0.88), (0, length * 0.97)]
        parts.append(raised_leaf_band('mint_central_midrib', outline, sections, fold_ratio, lift=0.52))
    if luminous:
        for u in (0.28, 0.5, 0.72):
            for side in (-1, 1):
                start = length * u
                end = start + length * 0.12
                reach = float(np.interp(end, np.array(sections)[:, 0], np.array(sections)[:, 1])) * 0.82
                outline = [(side * vein_width / 2, start), (side * reach / 2, start + vein_width), (side * reach, end), (side * reach / 2, start + vein_width * 2), (side * vein_width / 2, start + vein_width)]
                parts.append(raised_leaf_band('glowing_branch_vein', outline, sections, fold_ratio, lift=0.8))
    accents = s3d.merge(*parts)
    s3d.material(accents, 'leaf', color='#46ffab' if luminous else '#85ba98', roughness=0.95, emission=5 if luminous else 0)
    return accents

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random


def fantasy_jungle_potted_monstera(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    pot = angular_planter(seed=seed + 1)
    soil = s3d.at(soil_infill(seed=seed + 2), on=pot.soil)
    # Irregular shoot stages: azimuth, petiole reach, rise, blade scale, blade pitch.
    stages = [(155, 155, 420, 1.03, 48), (-48, 155, 475, .94, 55), (90, 185, 300, 1.02, -12), (-95, 190, 320, 1.0, -32), (190, 155, 230, .91, -40), (-145, 175, 270, .79, -25), (30, 145, 390, .83, 22)]
    shoots = [s3d.at(monstera_shoot(outreach=reach, rise=rise, leaf_scale=scale, tilt=tilt, seed=seed + 100 + i), on=pot.soil.turn(rz=azimuth)) for i, (azimuth, reach, rise, scale, tilt) in enumerate(stages)]
    return s3d.assembly('fantasy_jungle_potted_monstera', pot, soil, *shoots)


def angular_planter(seed=1, bottom_d=330, mouth_d=420, height=245, wall=20, rim_h=40, rim_overhang=12, foot_h=14):
    body = s3d.shell(s3d.cone('tapered_purple_terracotta', bottom_d, height, d2=mouth_d), wall, open='top')
    s3d.material(body, 'ceramic', color='#70404b', roughness=.9)
    rim = s3d.at(s3d.tube('thick_square_rim', mouth_d + 2 * rim_overhang, mouth_d - 2 * wall, rim_h), z=height-rim_h/2)
    s3d.material(rim, 'ceramic', color='#874a60', roughness=.88)
    foot = s3d.cylinder('planter_foot', bottom_d, foot_h)
    s3d.material(foot, 'ceramic', color='#62334f', roughness=.95)
    all_parts = s3d.group('angular_planter', body, rim, foot)
    all_parts = s3d.at(all_parts, rz=45)
    return s3d.assembly('planter', all_parts, soil=s3d.Frame((0, 0, height-rim_h/2-wall/2)))


def soil_infill(seed=2, diameter=377, thickness=18):
    soil = s3d.cylinder('visible_dark_soil', diameter, thickness)
    s3d.material(soil, 'soil', color='#30243c', roughness=1)
    return s3d.at(soil, rz=45)


def monstera_shoot(outreach=160, rise=400, leaf_scale=1, tilt=40, seed=100, stem_d=17, root_spread=28):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    root_x = rng.uniform(-root_spread, root_spread)
    roll = rng.uniform(-14, 14)
    asymmetry = rng.uniform(.79, .96)
    path = s3d.spline([(root_x, 0, -12), (root_x/2, outreach*.24, rise*.43), (0, outreach*.72, rise*.83), (0, outreach, rise)])
    stalk = stalk_cluster(path, seed=seed+1, diameter=stem_d)
    endpoint = s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1]
    leaf_frame = s3d.Frame(origin=endpoint.origin).turn(rx=tilt, ry=roll)
    blade = s3d.at(leaf_blade(seed=seed+2, asymmetry=asymmetry), on=leaf_frame, scale=leaf_scale)
    veins = s3d.at(leaf_vein_ridges(seed=seed+3, asymmetry=asymmetry), on=leaf_frame, scale=leaf_scale)
    return s3d.group('monstera_shoot', stalk, blade, veins)


def stalk_cluster(path, seed=101, diameter=17):
    stalk = s3d.wire('thick_angular_green_petiole', path, d=[(0,diameter*1.2),(1,diameter*.72)])
    s3d.material(stalk, 'plastic', color='#25835a', roughness=.92)
    return stalk


def leaf_blade(seed=102, width=365, length=350, thickness=8, fold=44, asymmetry=.88):
    half = leaf_half(width=width, length=length, thickness=thickness, fold=fold, seed=seed)
    other = s3d.transform(s3d.scale(s3d.copy(half), (asymmetry,1,1)), mirror='x')
    blade = s3d.join(half, other)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Authored reflectance palette: emerald/jade face, violet reverse, dark green cut edges.
    jade = np.array(rng.choice([(.04,.35,.23),(.07,.48,.31),(.04,.42,.26)]))
    violet = np.array([.35, .12, .48])
    edge = np.array([.09, .29, .25])
    s3d.material(blade, 'leaf', color=lambda x,y,z,n: np.where((n[2] < -.2)[:,None], violet, np.where((n[2] > .2)[:,None], jade, edge)), roughness=.87)
    return blade


def leaf_half(width=365, length=350, thickness=8, fold=44, seed=103, notch=.16, hole_w=.065, hole_l=.11):
    # A heart shoulder followed by three progressively smaller split lobes.
    # Each row gives outer, incision and next-lobe landmarks in normalized half-width and length.
    lobe_landmarks = [(1,.32,.43,.30,.95,.40),(.82,.56,.35,.52,.72,.64),(.52,.76,.21,.70,.39,.84)]
    outline = [(0,notch),(.20,0),(.40,.05),(.50,.21)]
    for outer_x, outer_y, cut_x, cut_y, next_x, next_y in lobe_landmarks:
        outline.extend([(outer_x/2,outer_y),(cut_x/2,cut_y),(next_x/2,next_y)])
    outline.append((0,1))
    profile = s3d.poly([(x*width,(y-notch)*length) for x,y in outline])
    half = s3d.extrude('angular_split_leaf_half', profile, thickness)
    hole = s3d.extrude('enclosed_fenestration_tool', s3d.rect(width*hole_w, length*hole_l, chamfer=width*hole_w/3), thickness*3)
    holes = s3d.at(hole, on=s3d.grid(1,3,py=length*.18).move(x=width*.085,y=length*(.48-notch),z=-thickness), scale=[1,.83,.65])
    half = s3d.cut(half, holes)
    half = s3d.displace(half, fold, width, noise=lambda x,y,z: -np.abs(x)/(width/2), direction='+Z', step=0)
    return half


def leaf_vein_ridges(seed=104, width=365, length=350, thickness=8, fold=44, ridge_d=10, notch=.16, asymmetry=.88):
    midrib = s3d.wire('lime_mid_rib', [(0,0,thickness+2),(0,length*(1-notch),thickness+2)], d=[(0,ridge_d),(1,ridge_d*.35)])
    s3d.material(midrib, 'plastic', color='#a5d642', roughness=1)
    branches = []
    # Veins terminate within the three intact lateral lobes, between the fenestrations.
    stages = [(.18,.38,.22),(.37,.34,.46),(.56,.22,.68)]
    for ybase, xend, yend in stages:
        branch = s3d.wire('angular_lateral_vein', [(0,(ybase-notch)*length,thickness+2),(xend*width,(yend-notch)*length,thickness+2-fold*xend*2)], d=[(0,ridge_d*.72),(1,ridge_d*.3)])
        s3d.material(branch, 'plastic', color='#96ce3a', roughness=1)
        branches.append(branch)
        branches.append(s3d.transform(s3d.scale(s3d.copy(branch),(asymmetry,1,1)),mirror='x'))
    return s3d.group('raised_lime_veins', midrib, *branches)

import sand3d as s3d
import random
import numpy as np

def alien_alpine_drystone_wall(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    foundation, foot = foundation_stones(seed=seed + 11)
    lower, low = lower_courses(foot, seed=seed + 23)
    middle, mid = middle_courses(low, seed=seed + 37)
    upper, high = upper_course(mid, seed=seed + 51)
    crest, caps = broken_crest(high, seed=seed + 67)
    minerals = embedded_mineral_seams(foot + low + mid + high + caps, seed=seed + 83)
    return s3d.assembly('alien_alpine_drystone_wall', foundation, lower, middle, upper, crest, minerals)

def foundation_stones(seed=0, width=1840, depth=590, height=192, count=5):
    stones, records = stone_course(width, depth, height, count, [], seed, 'foundation', foundation=True)
    return (s3d.group('foundation_stones', *stones), records)

def stone_course(width, depth, height, count, support, seed, name, foundation=False, crest=False, gap=8, width_spread=0.27, height_spread=0.04, xshift=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    weights = [rng.uniform(1 - width_spread, 1 + width_spread) for i in range(count)]
    lengths = [v / sum(weights) * width for v in weights]
    x = -width / 2 + xshift
    stones, records = ([], [])
    for i, length in enumerate(lengths):
        w = length - gap
        center = x + length / 2
        overlap = [r for r in support if min(center + w / 2, r['x'] + r['w'] / 2) - max(center - w / 2, r['x'] - r['w'] / 2) > gap]
        z = max([r['z'] + r['h'] for r in overlap], default=0) + (0 if foundation else 1)
        h = height * rng.uniform(1 - height_spread, 1 + height_spread)
        if crest:
            h *= 0.53 if i in (0, count - 1) else rng.uniform(0.76, 1.52)
        d = depth * rng.uniform(0.94, 1)
        y = rng.uniform(-gap, gap)
        block = angular_stone(w, d, h, seed + 101 + i, name + '_' + str(i))
        block = s3d.at(block, x=center, y=y, z=z)
        stones.append(block)
        records.append({'part': block, 'x': center, 'y': y, 'z': z, 'w': w, 'd': d, 'h': h})
        x += length
    return (stones, records)

def angular_stone(w, d, h, seed=0, name='stone', bevel=0.12, drift=0.045):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    corners = [(-0.5 + bevel, -0.5), (0.5 - bevel, -0.5), (0.5, -0.5 + bevel), (0.5, 0.5 - bevel), (0.5 - bevel, 0.5), (-0.5 + bevel, 0.5), (-0.5, 0.5 - bevel), (-0.5, -0.5 + bevel)]
    points = []
    for level, inset in [(0, 0.91), (0.28, 1), (0.74, 0.99), (1, 0.86)]:
        dx, dy = (rng.uniform(-drift, drift) * w, rng.uniform(-drift, drift) * d)
        for px, py in corners:
            jitter = rng.uniform(0.96, 1.04)
            points.append((px * w * inset * jitter + dx, py * d * inset * jitter + dy, level * h))
    stone = s3d.hull(name, points)
    palette = ['#302b40', '#383047', '#42384d', '#4a4055', '#34333f', '#6f617b']
    tint = palette[rng.randrange(len(palette))]
    base = np.array([int(tint[j:j + 2], 16) / 255 for j in (1, 3, 5)])

    def rock_colour(x, y, z):
        variation = 0.94 + 0.13 * s3d.noise(x / 93, y / 93, z / 93, seed=seed)
        return np.clip(variation[:, None] * base[None, :], 0, 1)
    s3d.material(stone, 'rock', color=rock_colour, roughness=0.94)
    return stone

def lower_courses(support, seed=0, width=1790, depth=530, height=152):
    first, a = stone_course(width, depth, height, 6, support, seed + 1, 'lower_a', xshift=15)
    second, b = stone_course(width - 28, depth - 30, height, 5, a, seed + 2, 'lower_b', xshift=-18)
    return (s3d.group('lower_courses', *first, *second), a + b)

def middle_courses(support, seed=0, width=1730, depth=458, height=185):
    stones, records = stone_course(width, depth, height, 6, support, seed, 'middle', xshift=-55)
    return (s3d.group('middle_courses', *stones), records)

def upper_course(support, seed=0, width=1640, depth=390, height=175):
    stones, records = stone_course(width, depth, height, 5, support, seed, 'upper', xshift=5)
    return (s3d.group('upper_course', *stones), records)

def broken_crest(support, seed=0, width=1530, depth=340, height=100, remnant_height=112):
    stones, records = stone_course(width, depth, height, 6, support, seed, 'crest', crest=True, xshift=-55)
    remnants = []
    extra = []
    for i, factor in [(1, 1), (3, 0.88)]:
        host = records[i]
        w, d, h = (host['w'] * 0.92, host['d'] * 0.88, remnant_height * factor)
        cap = angular_stone(w, d, h, seed + 101 + i, 'broken_crest_remnant')
        cap = s3d.at(cap, on=s3d.local(host['part'], z=host['h']))
        remnants.append(cap)
        extra.append({'part': cap, 'x': host['x'], 'y': host['y'], 'z': host['z'] + host['h'], 'w': w, 'd': d, 'h': h})
    return (s3d.group('broken_crest', *stones, *remnants), records + extra)

def embedded_mineral_seams(records, seed=0, count=13, seam_width=8, relief=0.9):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    candidates = rng.sample(records, min(count, len(records)))
    seams = []
    for i, r in enumerate(candidates):
        side = -1 if i % 2 == 0 else 1
        path = [(-r['w'] * 0.3, side * r['d'], r['h'] * 0.3), (-r['w'] * 0.1, side * r['d'], r['h'] * 0.48), (r['w'] * 0.09, side * r['d'], r['h'] * 0.54), (r['w'] * 0.28, side * r['d'], r['h'] * 0.76)]
        local_points = [(p[0] + r['x'], p[1] + r['y'], p[2] + r['z']) for p in path]
        hits = s3d.snap(r['part'], local_points, direction='+Y' if side < 0 else '-Y')
        if len(hits) < 2:
            continue
        for j in range(len(hits) - 1):
            a, b = (hits[j].origin, hits[j + 1].origin)
            points = [(a.x, a.y + side * relief, a.z - seam_width / 2), (a.x, a.y + side * relief, a.z + seam_width / 2), (b.x, b.y + side * relief, b.z - seam_width / 2), (b.x, b.y + side * relief, b.z + seam_width / 2), (a.x, a.y - side * relief, a.z - seam_width / 2), (b.x, b.y - side * relief, b.z + seam_width / 2)]
            seam = s3d.hull('mineral_fracture', points)
            s3d.material(seam, 'rock', color='#60c9cb' if i % 3 else '#a1e2df', roughness=0.73)
            seams.append(seam)
    return s3d.group('embedded_mineral_seams', *seams)

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import math
import random

def rustic_rocking_chair_spring_meadow(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    ground_h, rail_length, rail_rise, rail_t = (40, 1060, 80, 46)
    rail_x, leg_y, seat_z, seat_d = (285, 220, 475, 540)
    back_h, back_lean = (625, 150)
    contact = ground_h + rail_t + rail_rise * (2 * leg_y / rail_length) ** 2
    ground = meadow_ground(seed=seed + 1, h=ground_h)
    grass = spring_grass_tufts(ground, seed=seed + 2, rail_x=rail_x)
    runners = s3d.at(rocker_rails(seed=seed + 3, length=rail_length, rise=rail_rise, thickness=rail_t), x=rail_x, z=ground_h)
    runner_twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(runners), mirror='x')
    legs = s3d.at(leg_frames(seed=seed + 4, height=seat_z - contact, foot_y=leg_y), x=rail_x, z=contact - 2)
    leg_twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(legs), mirror='x')
    stretchers = s3d.at(underseat_stretchers(seed=seed + 5), z=seat_z - 55)
    braces = s3d.at(angular_cross_bracing(seed=seed + 6), x=rail_x - 5, z=175)
    brace_twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(braces), mirror='x')
    seat = s3d.at(plank_seat(seed=seed + 7, depth=seat_d), y=-15, z=seat_z)
    back = s3d.at(back_frame(seed=seed + 8, height=back_h, lean=back_lean), y=200, z=seat_z)
    slats = s3d.at(back_slats(seed=seed + 9, height=back_h, lean=back_lean), y=200, z=seat_z)
    arms = s3d.at(open_armrests(seed=seed + 10), x=rail_x, z=seat_z)
    arm_twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(arms), mirror='x')
    vignette = s3d.assembly('rustic_rocking_chair_spring_meadow', ground, grass, runners, runner_twin, legs, leg_twin, stretchers, braces, brace_twin, seat, back, slats, arms, arm_twin)
    return s3d.transform(vignette, rz=180)

def meadow_ground(seed=0, width=1240, depth=1280, h=40, irregularity=24):
    outline = s3d.ring(11, width / 2, start=12).jitter(x=irregularity, y=irregularity, seed=seed)
    points = [(f.origin.x, f.origin.y * depth / width) for f in outline]
    soil = s3d.extrude('bounded_earth_patch', s3d.poly(points), h)
    soil_rgb, pigment_variation, patch_size, edge_tone = (np.array([0.34, 0.24, 0.14]), 0.1, 240, 0.72)

    def earth(x, y, z, n):
        patch = s3d.noise(x / patch_size, y / patch_size, z / patch_size, seed=seed + 1)
        tone = np.where(n[2] > 0.5, 1.0, edge_tone)
        return soil_rgb * ((1 + pigment_variation * patch) * tone)[..., None]
    s3d.material(soil, 'soil', color=earth, roughness=1)
    return soil

def spring_grass_tufts(ground, seed=0, count=380, rail_x=285, rail_clearance=65):
    sites = s3d.scatter(count, ground, seed=seed)
    kept = [f for f in sites if f.normal.z > 0.9 and (not (abs(abs(f.origin.x) - rail_x) < rail_clearance and abs(f.origin.y) < 550))]
    populations = [s3d.Frames(kept[i::3]) for i in range(3)]
    colors = ['#79a643', '#94b94c', '#527d30']
    grass = []
    for i, frames in enumerate(populations):
        tuft = s3d.tufts('spring_pointed_tufts', frames, height=lambda x, y, z, n: 42 + 22 * (0.5 + 0.5 * s3d.noise(x / 180, y / 180, z / 180, seed=seed + 12)), width=11, blades=5, lean=27, shape='blade', seed=seed + 20 + i)
        s3d.material(tuft, 'grass', color=colors[i], roughness=1)
        grass.append(tuft)
    return s3d.group('sparse_spring_meadow_grass', *grass)

def rocker_rails(seed=0, length=1060, rise=80, thickness=46, width=48):
    samples = [i / 8 for i in range(-4, 5)]
    bottom = [(u * length, rise * (2 * u) ** 2) for u in samples]
    top = [(u * length, thickness + rise * (2 * u) ** 2) for u in reversed(samples)]
    rail = s3d.extrude('faceted_curved_rocker', s3d.poly(bottom + top), width, both=True)
    timber_material(rail, seed=seed, color='#805431', grain_axis=0)
    rail = s3d.at(rail, on=s3d.Frame(normal=(1, 0, 0), up=(0, 0, 1)))
    return s3d.group('curved_runner', rail)

def timber_material(ob, seed=0, color='#99683e', grain_axis=2, patch_size=155, end_tone=0.52, weathering=0.32):
    rgb = np.array([int(color[i:i + 2], 16) / 255 for i in (1, 3, 5)])
    worn_rgb = np.array([0.57, 0.5, 0.39])

    def weathered(x, y, z, n):
        patch = s3d.noise(x / patch_size, y / patch_size, z / patch_size, seed=seed)
        wear = weathering * np.clip(0.5 + patch, 0, 1)
        end = np.where(np.abs(n[grain_axis]) > 0.85, end_tone, 1.0)
        pigment = rgb * (1 - wear[..., None]) + worn_rgb * wear[..., None]
        return np.clip((1 + 0.15 * patch)[..., None] * end[..., None] * pigment, 0, 1)
    s3d.material(ob, 'oak', color=weathered, roughness=1)
    return ob

def leg_frames(seed=0, height=375, foot_y=220, top_y=200, splay=25, stock=47):
    leg = connected_beam((0, -foot_y, 0), (-splay, -top_y, height), seed=seed, width=stock, depth=stock, color='#a07549')
    rear = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(leg), mirror='y')
    return s3d.group('sturdy_splayed_side_legs', leg, rear)

def connected_beam(start, end, seed=0, width=42, depth=42, color='#99683e'):
    direction = tuple((b - a for a, b in zip(start, end)))
    length = math.sqrt(sum((v * v for v in direction)))
    return s3d.at(timber_beam(seed=seed, width=width, depth=depth, length=length, color=color), on=s3d.Frame(origin=start, normal=direction))

def timber_beam(seed=0, width=42, depth=42, length=300, color='#99683e', bevel=2):
    beam = s3d.extrude('hewn_timber', s3d.rect(width, depth, chamfer=bevel), length)
    return timber_material(beam, seed=seed, color=color)

def underseat_stretchers(seed=0, width=565, depth=445, stock=36, height=55):
    front = connected_beam((-width / 2, -depth / 2, height / 2), (width / 2, -depth / 2, height / 2), seed=seed, width=height, depth=stock, color='#825837')
    rear = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(front), mirror='y')
    side = connected_beam((width / 2, -depth / 2, height / 2), (width / 2, depth / 2, height / 2), seed=seed + 1, width=stock, depth=height, color='#8e603b')
    twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(side), mirror='x')
    return s3d.group('underseat_apron_frame', front, rear, side, twin)

def angular_cross_bracing(seed=0, span=412, rise=255, width=28, depth=22, lap=11):
    diagonal = connected_beam((-lap / 2, -span / 2, 0), (-lap / 2, span / 2, rise), seed=seed, width=width, depth=depth, color='#8b613c')
    other = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(diagonal), mirror='y')
    return s3d.group('side_x_braces', diagonal, other)

def plank_seat(seed=0, width=620, depth=540, thickness=39, count=6, gap=5):
    sites = s3d.grid(count, 1, px=width / count)
    shades = ['#a47b51', '#ac8050', '#986c43', '#b18a5c', '#9e774c', '#aa7a49']
    planks = [s3d.at(seat_plank(seed=seed + 20 + i, width=width / count - gap, depth=depth, thickness=thickness, color=shades[i % len(shades)]), on=f) for i, f in enumerate(sites)]
    return s3d.group('broad_gapped_plank_seat', *planks)

def seat_plank(seed=0, width=98, depth=540, thickness=39, uneven=6, color='#a47b51'):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    left, right = (-width / 2, width / 2)
    nose, tail = (-depth / 2 + rng.uniform(-uneven, uneven), depth / 2 + rng.uniform(-uneven, uneven))
    outline = [(left, nose), (right - uneven, nose - uneven / 2), (right, 0), (right - uneven / 2, tail), (left + uneven, tail), (left - uneven / 2, 0)]
    plank = s3d.extrude('uneven_seat_board', s3d.poly(outline), thickness)
    return timber_material(plank, seed=seed + 1, color=color, grain_axis=1)

def back_frame(seed=0, height=625, lean=150, width=520, stock=44):
    post = connected_beam((width / 2, 0, 0), (width / 2, lean, height), seed=seed, width=stock, depth=stock, color='#967047')
    twin = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(post), mirror='x')
    top = connected_beam((-width / 2 - stock / 2, lean, height - stock / 2), (width / 2 + stock / 2, lean, height - stock / 2), seed=seed + 1, width=stock, depth=62, color='#a87c4d')
    lower_z = stock * 2
    lower = connected_beam((-width / 2, lean * lower_z / height, lower_z), (width / 2, lean * lower_z / height, lower_z), seed=seed + 2, width=stock, depth=stock, color='#835a38')
    return s3d.group('leaning_back_posts_and_rails', post, twin, top, lower)

def back_slats(seed=0, height=625, lean=150, width=442, count=5, board_w=68, thickness=27, lower=72, upper_gap=48):
    positions = s3d.grid(count, 1, px=(width - board_w) / (count - 1))
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    slats = []
    for i, f in enumerate(positions):
        length = (height - lower - upper_gap + rng.uniform(-8, 8)) * math.sqrt(1 + (lean / height) ** 2)
        slat = seat_plank(seed=seed + 30 + i, width=board_w + rng.uniform(-4, 4), depth=length, thickness=thickness, uneven=5, color=['#a97e51', '#91683f', '#b18a5a'][i % 3])
        norm = math.sqrt(height * height + lean * lean)
        center = (f.origin.x, lean * lower / height - 12 + lean / norm * length / 2, lower + height / norm * length / 2)
        frame = s3d.Frame(origin=center, normal=(0, -height, lean), up=(0, lean, height))
        slats.append(s3d.at(slat, on=frame))
    return s3d.group('five_mismatched_back_slats', *slats)

def open_armrests(seed=0, arm_height=245, board_t=34, board_w=76, front=-300, rear=264, post_y=-215, stock=37):
    post = connected_beam((0, post_y, 0), (0, post_y, arm_height - board_t), seed=seed, width=stock, depth=stock, color='#9c7146')
    board = s3d.at(seat_plank(seed=seed + 1, width=board_w, depth=rear - front, thickness=board_t, uneven=2, color='#ad8454'), y=(rear + front) / 2, z=arm_height - board_t)
    return s3d.group('open_arm_and_front_support', post, board)

import sand3d as s3d
import random


def snow_covered_hay_roll(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(4, smooth=False)
    soil = soil_patch(seed=seed + 1)
    body = hay_roll_body(seed=seed + 2)
    spiral = s3d.at(rolled_straw_spiral(seed=seed + 3), on=body.near_end)
    ridges = lengthwise_straw_ridges(body, seed=seed + 4)
    cap = upper_snow_cap(body, seed=seed + 5)
    other_end = s3d.transform(s3d.copy(spiral), mirror='y')
    roll = s3d.at(s3d.group('snowy_hay', body, spiral, other_end, ridges, cap), z=620)
    patches = ground_snow_patches(soil, seed=seed + 6)
    grass = sparse_grass_tufts(soil, patches, seed=seed + 7)
    return s3d.assembly('snow_covered_hay_roll', soil, roll, patches, grass)


def soil_patch(seed=0, width=1800, depth=1600, height=60, corners=11, irregularity=65):
    sites = s3d.ring(corners, 1).jitter(x=irregularity / width, y=irregularity / depth, seed=seed)
    outline = s3d.poly([(f.origin.x * width / 2, f.origin.y * depth / 2) for f in sites])
    soil = s3d.extrude('irregular_soil', outline, height)
    s3d.material(soil, 'soil', color='#684934', roughness=1)
    return soil


def hay_roll_body(seed=0, radius=560, length=1000, sides=12, end_skin=8):
    hay = s3d.at(s3d.extrude('polygonal_hay', s3d.polygon(sides, radius * 2), length, both=True), rx=90)
    s3d.material(hay, 'plastic', color='#bd862c', roughness=1)
    end = s3d.at(s3d.extrude('packed_straw_end', s3d.polygon(sides, radius * 2 - end_skin), end_skin), y=-length / 2, rx=90)
    s3d.material(end, 'plastic', color='#d49f43', roughness=1)
    return s3d.assembly('hay_roll_body', hay, end, near_end=s3d.Frame((0, -length / 2 - end_skin, 0), normal=(0, -1, 0), up=(0, 0, 1)))


def rolled_straw_spiral(seed=0, inner_r=48, outer_r=526, turns=4, corners=12, band=76, seam=13, relief=13):
    directions = list(s3d.ring(corners, 1, start=15 + seed % corners))
    winding = directions * turns + directions[:1]
    radii = [inner_r + (outer_r - inner_r) * k / (len(winding)-1) for k, f in enumerate(winding)]
    points = [(f.origin.x*r, f.origin.y*r, relief) for f,r in zip(winding,radii)]
    channel = s3d.wire('rolled_straw_dark_seam', points, d=band)
    s3d.material(channel, 'plastic', color='#9a6627', roughness=1)
    strand = s3d.wire('broad_golden_spiral', [(x,y,z+seam) for x,y,z in points], d=band-seam*2)
    s3d.material(strand, 'plastic', color='#e6b653', roughness=1)
    heart = s3d.extrude('straw_core', s3d.polygon(7, inner_r * 1.5), relief * 2)
    s3d.material(heart, 'plastic', color='#d9a044', roughness=1)
    return s3d.group('rolled_straw_spiral', channel, strand, heart)


def lengthwise_straw_ridges(body, seed=0, radius=560, count=48, length=1000, width=23, variation=24):
    sites = s3d.ring(count, radius * 1.3, start=4, on=s3d.Frame(normal=(0,-1,0), up=(0,0,1)))
    hits = s3d.snap(body, sites)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    parts = []
    palette = ['#e5b44e', '#c98f30', '#dca23e', '#b97c25']
    for i, f in enumerate(hits):
        p = f.origin
        start = -length / 2 - rng.uniform(0, variation)
        end = length / 2 + rng.uniform(0, variation)
        ridge = s3d.wire('long_straw_ridge', [(p.x,start,p.z),(p.x,end,p.z)], d=width * rng.uniform(.6, 1.3))
        s3d.material(ridge, 'plastic', color=palette[i % len(palette)], roughness=1)
        parts.append(ridge)
    return s3d.group('lengthwise_straw_ridges', *parts)


def upper_snow_cap(body, seed=0, radius=560, depth=1000, thickness=110, overhang=52):
    # The lower contour is sampled on the actual twelve-sided hay crown.
    probes = s3d.grid(5, 1, radius * .43).move(z=radius * 2)
    hits = s3d.snap(body, probes, direction='-Z')
    underside = [(f.origin.x, f.origin.z - 8) for f in hits]
    underside.sort()
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    crown = [(x * (1 + overhang / radius), z + thickness + rng.uniform(-12, 12)) for x,z in underside]
    profile = s3d.poly(underside + list(reversed(crown)))
    snow = s3d.at(s3d.extrude('thick_crown_snow', profile, depth + overhang * 3, both=True), rx=90)
    half = radius + overhang
    front = -depth / 2 - overhang
    back = depth / 2 + overhang / 2
    footprint = [(-half, front+overhang),(-radius*.65,front-overhang*.9),(-radius*.28,front+overhang*1.25),(radius*.12,front-overhang*1.15),(radius*.5,front+overhang*.4),(half,front+overhang), (radius*.81,-depth*.28),(radius*.96,-depth*.07),(radius*.83,depth*.2),(half,back-overhang*.3),(radius*.55,back+overhang*.4),(0,back),( -radius*.6,back+overhang*.3),(-half,back-overhang),(-radius*.82,depth*.21),(-radius*.97,-depth*.05),(-radius*.80,-depth*.29)]
    limit = s3d.at(s3d.extrude('snow_perimeter_tool', s3d.poly(footprint), radius*3), z=-radius)
    snow = s3d.intersect(snow, limit)
    s3d.material(snow, 'plastic', color='#aabccc', roughness=1, metallic=0, emission=0)
    return snow


def ground_snow_patches(soil, seed=0, height=24, corner_count=7):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # A few deliberately separate islands leave the soil visible.
    layout = [(-650,-320,260,210), (590,-390,290,220), (-310,-650,260,150), (350,-670,330,150), (-630,300,280,270), (570,370,300,250), (10,625,360,160)]
    parts = []
    for i,(x,y,w,d) in enumerate(layout):
        probe = s3d.Frames([s3d.Frame((x,y,200))])
        hit = s3d.snap(soil, probe, direction='-Z')[0]
        ring = s3d.ring(corner_count, 1).jitter(x=.15,y=.15, seed=seed+i+1)
        profile = s3d.poly([(f.origin.x*w/2,f.origin.y*d/2) for f in ring])
        patch = s3d.extrude('fallen_snow_patch', profile, height*rng.uniform(.6,1.2), taper=20)
        s3d.material(patch, 'plastic', color='#c1ccd4', roughness=1, metallic=0, emission=0)
        parts.append(s3d.at(patch,on=hit))
    return s3d.group('ground_snow_patches', *parts)


def sparse_grass_tufts(soil, snow, seed=0, candidates=150, height=95, width=20):
    sites = s3d.scatter(candidates, soil, seed=seed)
    exposed = [f for f in sites if f.origin.z > 59 and (abs(f.origin.x)>585 or abs(f.origin.y)>570)]
    probes = s3d.Frames(s3d.Frame((f.origin.x,f.origin.y,200)) for f in exposed)
    snow_hits = s3d.snap(snow, probes, direction='-Z')
    kept = s3d.Frames(f for f in exposed if not any((f.origin.x-h.origin.x)**2+(f.origin.y-h.origin.y)**2 < 1 for h in snow_hits))
    grass = s3d.tufts('sparse_winter_grass', kept, height=height, width=width, blades=4, lean=30, seed=seed+1)
    s3d.material(grass, 'grass', color='#88804a', roughness=1)
    return grass

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random


def overgrown_polygonal_tree_bench(seed=0):
    s3d.facets(6, smooth=False)
    seat = seat_ring(seed=seed+1)
    frame = bench_underframe(seed=seed+2)
    legs = timber_leg(seed=seed+3)
    trunk = crooked_trunk(seed=seed+4)
    roots = exposed_root(seed=seed+5)
    branches = canopy_branch(seed=seed+6)
    crown = foliage_cluster(branches, seed=seed+7)
    moss = moss_patch(seat, legs, roots, seed=seed+8)
    vines = leafy_vine(seed=seed+9)
    return s3d.assembly('overgrown_polygonal_tree_bench', seat, frame, legs, trunk, roots, branches, crown, moss, vines)


def wood_colour(x,y,z):
    v = .035*np.sin(x/165+y/235+z/94)
    return np.stack((.64+v,.365+v*.8,.145+v*.45),axis=-1)


def bark_colour(x,y,z):
    v = .025*np.sin(x/112+y/83+z/190)
    return np.stack((.24+v,.165+v,.105+v*.6),axis=-1)


def leaf_colour(x,y,z):
    v = .045*np.sin(x/207+y/166+z/153)
    return np.stack((.075+v*.5,.38+v,.155+v*.7),axis=-1)


def moss_colour(x,y,z):
    v = .045*np.sin(x/70+y/87+z/49)
    return np.stack((.48+v,.61+v,.105+v*.5),axis=-1)


def seat_ring(seed=1, inner=465, outer=1120, height=460, thick=85, courses=3, gap=9, bevel=11):
    parts=[]
    pitch=(outer-inner)/courses
    for k in range(courses):
        a=inner+k*pitch+gap/2
        b=inner+(k+1)*pitch-gap/2
        profile=s3d.poly([(-a/np.sqrt(3)+gap/2,a),(a/np.sqrt(3)-gap/2,a),(b/np.sqrt(3)-gap/2,b),(-b/np.sqrt(3)+gap/2,b)])
        plank=s3d.extrude('broad_seat_plank',profile,thick)
        plank=s3d.chamfer(plank,bevel)
        s3d.material(plank,'oak',color=wood_colour,roughness=.78)
        parts+=s3d.at(plank,on=s3d.ring(6,0,start=0),z=height-thick)
    return s3d.group('seat_ring',parts)


def bench_underframe(seed=2, radius=780, rail=95, height=345, depth=110):
    beam=s3d.box('heavy_underseat_rail',radius*2/np.sqrt(3),rail,depth)
    beam=s3d.chamfer(beam,8)
    s3d.material(beam,'oak',color=wood_colour)
    rails=s3d.at(beam,on=s3d.ring(6,radius,start=30).turn(rz=90),z=height-depth/2)
    return s3d.group('bench_underframe',rails)


def timber_leg(seed=3, radius=885, width=145, depth=155, height=385, splay=55):
    leg=s3d.loft('stout_splayed_leg',s3d.station(0,width+15,depth+15,y=splay,n=4),s3d.station(height,width,depth,n=4))
    leg=s3d.chamfer(leg,9)
    s3d.material(leg,'oak',color=wood_colour)
    legs=s3d.at(leg,on=s3d.ring(6,radius,start=30))
    return s3d.group('timber_leg',legs)


def crooked_trunk(seed=4, height=2180, base=390):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    lean=rng.uniform(65,110)
    trunk=s3d.loft('crooked_living_trunk',s3d.station(0,base*1.35,base*1.2,n=2),s3d.station(height*.15,base,base*.88,x=-25,y=12),s3d.station(height*.38,base*.83,base*.78,x=lean,y=10),s3d.station(height*.6,base*.68,base*.61,x=-40,y=38),s3d.station(height*.8,base*.47,base*.42,x=70,y=10),s3d.station(height,base*.24,base*.22,x=15,y=40))
    s3d.material(trunk,'bark',color=bark_colour)
    return trunk


def exposed_root(seed=5, count=7, length=880, base=235, h=180):
    lengths=s3d.vary(length,150,count,seed=seed)
    sites=s3d.ring(count,0,start=10).jitter(rz=10,seed=seed+1)
    roots=[]
    for i,(f,l) in enumerate(zip(sites,lengths)):
        root=s3d.loft('exposed_tapered_root',s3d.station(0,base,base*.85,n=2),s3d.station(l*.45,base*.62,base*.5,x=base*.12,y=-h*.2),s3d.station(l*.8,base*.29,base*.22,x=-base*.12,y=-h*.8),s3d.station(l,12,12,y=-h+6))
        root=s3d.at(root,on=f.turn(rx=90),z=h)
        s3d.material(root,'bark',color=bark_colour)
        roots.append(root)
    return s3d.group('exposed_root',roots)


def canopy_branch(seed=6, h=1410, count=6, reach=740, rise=650, diameter=145):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    sites=s3d.ring(count,0,start=15).jitter(rz=12,seed=seed+1)
    parts=[]
    tips={}
    for i,f in enumerate(sites):
        length=reach*rng.uniform(.75,1.15)
        lift=rise*rng.uniform(.65,1.15)
        path=[(0,0,0),(length*.32,0,lift*.4),(length*.7,35,lift*.65),(length,55,lift)]
        branch=s3d.wire('crooked_canopy_branch',path,[(0,diameter),(0.45,diameter*.68),(1,35)],tip='flat')
        s3d.material(branch,'bark',color=bark_colour)
        attachment=f.move(z=h+(i%2)*180)
        parts.append(s3d.at(branch,on=attachment))
        tips['tip'+str(i)]=attachment.move(x=length,y=55,z=lift)
    return s3d.assembly('canopy_branch',parts,**tips)


def foliage_cluster(branches, seed=7, width=1000, depth=880, height=800):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    clusters=[]
    for i in range(6):
        f=getattr(branches,'tip'+str(i))
        cluster=angular_foliage(seed=seed+100+i,width=width*rng.uniform(.85,1.1),depth=depth*rng.uniform(.85,1.12),height=height*rng.uniform(.8,1.1))
        clusters.append(s3d.at(cluster,on=f,z=-height*.25))
    top=angular_foliage(seed=seed+200,width=width*1.05,depth=depth,height=height)
    clusters.append(s3d.at(top,x=15,y=40,z=2050))
    return s3d.group('foliage_cluster',clusters)


def angular_foliage(seed=100, width=1000, depth=900, height=800):
    sites=s3d.ring(6,1,start=0).jitter(rz=13,seed=seed)
    rng=random.Random(seed+1)
    points=[]
    for level,ratio in [(0,.45),(.25,1),(.68,.9),(1,.3)]:
        for f in sites:
            points.append((f.origin.x*width*.5*ratio*rng.uniform(.88,1.12),f.origin.y*depth*.5*ratio*rng.uniform(.88,1.12),height*level+rng.uniform(-height*.07,height*.07)))
    clump=s3d.hull('angular_emerald_foliage',points)
    s3d.material(clump,'leaf',color=leaf_colour,roughness=.85)
    return clump


def moss_patch(seat, legs, roots, seed=8, count=70):
    sites=s3d.scatter(count*2,seat,seed=seed)
    kept=[f for f in sites if f.normal.z>.8]
    rng=random.Random(seed+1)
    moss=[]
    for i,f in enumerate(kept[:count]):
        patch=s3d.at(s3d.scale(s3d.dome('seat_moss_cushion',rng.uniform(35,95),rng.uniform(6,16)),(1,.55,1)),on=f)
        s3d.material(patch,'moss',color=moss_colour)
        moss.append(patch)
    sites=s3d.scatter(70,legs,seed=seed+2)
    kept=[f for f in sites if f.origin.z<290]
    cushion=s3d.dome('leg_moss',55,12)
    s3d.material(cushion,'moss',color=moss_colour)
    moss+=s3d.at(cushion,on=s3d.Frames(kept))
    sites=s3d.scatter(30,roots,seed=seed+3)
    kept=[f for f in sites if f.normal.z>.4]
    cushion=s3d.dome('root_moss',65,13)
    s3d.material(cushion,'moss',color=moss_colour)
    moss+=s3d.at(cushion,on=s3d.Frames(kept))
    return s3d.group('moss_patch',moss)


def vine_colour(x,y,z):
    v=.04*np.sin(x/60+y/85+z/90)
    return np.stack((.25+v,.5+v,.10+v*.5),axis=-1)


def leafy_vine(seed=9, radius=885, seat_h=460):
    sites=s3d.ring(3,radius,start=30)
    vine=vine_sprig(seed=seed+1,height=seat_h)
    vines=s3d.at(vine,on=sites)
    return s3d.group('leafy_vine',vines)


def vine_sprig(seed=10,height=460, reach=270, leaf_size=115):
    path=[(90,-50,8),(100,35,height*.25),(90,70,height*.5),(95,-30,height*.8),(100,-25,height+15),(reach-10,0,height+25),(reach+25,15,height*.72),(reach+20,-20,height*.4)]
    stem=s3d.wire('trailing_vine_stem',path,15)
    s3d.material(stem,'leaf',color='#456229')
    sites=s3d.along(path,count=29,spin=137.508).turn(ry=65).jitter(rx=12,rz=20,seed=seed)
    leaf=s3d.hull('pointed_vine_leaf',[(0,0,0),(-leaf_size*.35,0,leaf_size*.45),(0,-9,leaf_size*.48),(leaf_size*.35,0,leaf_size*.45),(0,0,leaf_size)])
    s3d.material(leaf,'leaf',color=vine_colour)
    leaves=s3d.at(leaf,on=sites)
    return s3d.group('vine_sprig',stem,leaves)

import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random

def softly_rounded_mulberry_tree(seed=0):
    growth = growth_axes(seed=seed + 10)
    roots = supporting_roots(seed=seed + 20)
    trunk = flared_trunk(growth[0], seed=seed + 30)
    scaffolds = scaffold_limbs(growth[1], seed=seed + 40)
    twigs = drooping_branchlets(growth[1], seed=seed + 50)
    foliage = leaf_sprays(growth[1], seed=seed + 60)
    fruits = mulberry_fruits(growth[1], seed=seed + 70)
    return s3d.assembly('softly_rounded_mulberry_tree', roots, trunk, scaffolds, twigs, foliage, fruits)

def growth_axes(seed=0, trunk_h=2350, scaffold_l=2850, count=9):
    with s3d.facets(10, smooth=True):
        trunk = s3d.branches(trunk_h, 700, levels=0, wander=6, droop=0, seed=seed)
        forks = s3d.along(trunk[0].path, count=count, spin=137.508, span=(0.62, 0.98)).turn(ry=48)
        lengths = s3d.vary(scaffold_l, 420, count, seed=seed + 1)
        axes = []
        for k, (frame, length) in enumerate(zip(forks, lengths)):
            axes.extend(s3d.branches(length, 340, levels=3, children=3, attach=(0.47, 0.95), angle=36, azimuth=137.508, length_ratio=0.63, diameter_ratio=0.47, tip_ratio=0.16, jitter=0.19, seed=seed + 100 + k, on=frame, wander=12, droop=10))
    return (trunk[0], axes)

def supporting_roots(seed=0, reach=1380, count=7, rise=340):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    frames = s3d.ring(count, 90).jitter(rz=12, seed=seed + 1)
    parts = []
    with s3d.facets(12, smooth=True):
        for k, frame in enumerate(frames):
            length = reach * rng.uniform(0.72, 1.12)
            path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, rise), (length * 0.3, 0, rise * 0.72), (length * 0.66, length * 0.06, rise * 0.32), (length, length * 0.12, 25)])
            root = s3d.wire('exposed_supporting_root', path, [(0, 440), (0.33, 280), (0.72, 130), (1, 22)])
            parts.append(s3d.at(bark_material(root, seed + 10 + k), on=frame))
    return s3d.group('supporting_roots', parts)

def bark_material(ob, seed=0):

    def bark_color(x, y, z):
        coarse = s3d.noise(x / 170, y / 170, z / 340, seed=seed)
        grain = s3d.noise(x / 24, y / 24, z / 210, seed=seed + 1)
        tone = 0.045 * coarse + 0.025 * grain
        return np.stack((0.32 + tone, 0.285 + tone, 0.235 + tone), axis=-1)
    s3d.material(ob, 'bark', color=bark_color, roughness=0.89)
    return ob

def flared_trunk(axis, seed=0):
    with s3d.facets(24, smooth=True):
        trunk = s3d.wire('flared_trunk', axis.path, [(0, 1120), (0.12, 880), (0.36, 660), (0.72, 540), (1, 390)])
    s3d.displace(trunk, 15, 90, seed=seed + 1, direction='radial', step=85)
    bark_material(trunk, seed + 2)
    s3d.smooth(trunk, 180)
    return trunk

def scaffold_limbs(axes, seed=0):
    parts = []
    with s3d.facets(12, smooth=True):
        for axis in axes:
            if axis.level <= 1:
                branch = s3d.wire('rounded_scaffold', axis.path, axis.d)
                parts.append(branch)
    wood = s3d.merge(*parts)
    bark_material(wood, seed)
    return wood

def drooping_branchlets(axes, seed=0):
    parts = []
    with s3d.facets(5, smooth=True):
        for axis in axes:
            if axis.level >= 2:
                samples = s3d.along(axis.path, count=5)
                path = [tuple(frame.origin) for frame in samples]
                parts.append(s3d.wire('curved_drooping_branchlet', path, axis.d))
    wood = s3d.merge(*parts)
    bark_material(wood, seed)
    return wood

def leaf_sprays(axes, seed=0, count=18):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    banks = [[] for bank in range(24)]
    for k, axis in enumerate(axes):
        if axis.level == 0:
            continue
        amount = count if axis.level >= 2 else count // 2
        frames = s3d.along(axis.path, count=amount, spin=137.508, span=(0.13, 0.99)).turn(ry=68).jitter(rx=16, ry=20, rz=35, seed=seed + 100 + k)
        for frame in frames:
            banks[rng.randrange(len(banks))].append(frame)
    leaves = []
    for k, frames in enumerate(banks):
        leaf = leaf_part(seed=seed + 500 + k, variant=k)
        scales = s3d.vary(1, 0.24, len(frames), seed=seed + 600 + k)
        copies = s3d.at(leaf, on=s3d.Frames(frames), scale=scales)
        leaves.append(s3d.merge(*copies))
    return s3d.group('leaf_sprays', leaves)

def leaf_part(seed=0, variant=0, length=290, width=190, cup=15, thickness=1.8):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    length *= rng.uniform(0.88, 1.1)
    width *= rng.uniform(0.86, 1.1)
    with s3d.facets(4, smooth=True):
        blade = s3d.loft('soft_ovate_leaf', s3d.station(0, 0, 0), s3d.station(length * 0.27, width, thickness, y=cup * 0.5), s3d.station(length * 0.62, width * 0.81, thickness, y=cup), s3d.station(length, 0, 0, y=0))
    if variant == 23:
        s3d.delete(blade)
        blade = serrated_leaf(length, width, thickness, seed + 2)
    colors = ['#245729', '#306b30', '#377530', '#20572b', '#437d34', '#5d903d']
    s3d.material(blade, 'leaf', color=colors[variant % len(colors)], roughness=0.46)
    pieces = [blade]
    if variant == 0 or variant == 23:
        pieces.append(leaf_veins(length=length, cup=cup, seed=seed + 1))
    return s3d.merge(*pieces) if len(pieces) > 1 else blade

def serrated_leaf(length=290, width=190, thickness=1.8, seed=0):
    half_outline = [(0, 0), (0.28, 0.08), (0.39, 0.06), (0.37, 0.17), (0.48, 0.2), (0.43, 0.29), (0.5, 0.34), (0.44, 0.42), (0.48, 0.48), (0.39, 0.56), (0.4, 0.62), (0.29, 0.71), (0.3, 0.75), (0, 1)]
    side = [(x * width, z * length) for x, z in half_outline]
    outline = side + [(-x, z) for x, z in reversed(side[1:-1])]
    blade = s3d.extrude('serrated_mulberry_leaf', s3d.poly(outline), thickness)
    blade = s3d.bend(blade, 16, axis='+Y', toward='+Z', step=0)
    return s3d.at(blade, rx=90)

def leaf_veins(length=265, cup=15, seed=0, vein_d=1.6):
    with s3d.facets(4, smooth=True):
        path = [(0, -1, 0), (0, cup * 0.5 - 1, length * 0.27), (0, cup - 1, length * 0.62), (0, -1, length * 0.94)]
        vein = s3d.wire('central_leaf_vein', path, [(0, vein_d), (1, 0.35)])
    s3d.material(vein, 'leaf', color='#8b9e4b', roughness=0.6)
    return vein

def mulberry_fruits(axes, seed=0, count=27):
    eligible = [axis for axis in axes if axis.level == 3]
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    selected = rng.sample(eligible, min(count, len(eligible)))
    fruits = []
    for k, axis in enumerate(selected):
        frame = s3d.along(axis.path, count=3, spin=137.508, span=(0.25, 0.65))[1].turn(ry=110)
        fruits.append(s3d.at(mulberry_part(seed=seed + 100 + k, ripe=k % 3 != 0), on=frame))
    return s3d.group('mulberry_fruits', fruits)

def mulberry_part(seed=0, ripe=True, length=42, diameter=20):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    parts = []
    with s3d.facets(5, smooth=True):
        stem = s3d.cylinder('fruit_stalk', 1.3, 10)
        s3d.material(stem, 'leaf', color='#718646')
        parts.append(stem)
        sites = s3d.phyllotaxis(14, diameter * 0.65, h=length * 0.72)
        for frame in sites:
            bead = s3d.sphere('rounded_mulberry_drupelet', diameter * 0.37)
            color = rng.choice(['#22112b', '#281329', '#36152e']) if ripe else rng.choice(['#85323e', '#a5474b', '#71323e'])
            s3d.material(bead, 'glossy_plastic', color=color, roughness=0.34)
            parts.append(s3d.at(bead, on=frame.move(z=10 + length * 0.12)))
    return s3d.group('elongated_mulberry', parts)

items.program:
import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random

def winter_southern_magnolia(seed=0):
    roots = root_flare(seed=seed + 11)
    trunk, trunk_path = upright_trunk(seed=seed + 23)
    scaffolds, axes = scaffold_branches(trunk_path, seed=seed + 37)
    twigs, terminals = secondary_branches_and_twigs(axes, seed=seed + 53)
    foliage, leaf_sites, leaf_scales = evergreen_leaf_clusters(terminals, seed=seed + 71)
    ribs = leaf_midribs(leaf_sites, leaf_scales, seed=seed + 89)
    snow = winter_accents(axes, leaf_sites, leaf_scales, seed=seed + 107)
    return s3d.assembly('winter_southern_magnolia', roots, trunk, scaffolds, twigs, foliage, ribs, snow)

def root_flare(seed=11, foot=1120, neck=720, height=900, spread=1330, count=7):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    with s3d.facets(24, smooth=True):
        foot_solid = s3d.loft('flared_root_collar', s3d.station(0, foot, foot * 0.92, n=2.5), s3d.station(110, foot * 0.92, foot * 0.86), s3d.station(height * 0.48, neck * 1.1, neck), s3d.station(height, neck, neck * 0.94))
        s3d.displace(foot_solid, 24, 260, seed=seed + 1, step=130)
    roots = [foot_solid]
    for i, frame in enumerate(s3d.ring(count, 0).jitter(rz=13, seed=seed + 2)):
        length = spread * rng.uniform(0.75, 1.15)
        points = [(0, 0, 330), (length * 0.3, 0, 230), (length * 0.65, rng.uniform(-90, 90), 95), (length, 0, 18)]
        with s3d.facets(12, smooth=True):
            path = s3d.spline(points)
            root = s3d.wire('exposed_root', path, [(0, 400), (0.35, 250), (0.73, 115), (1, 22)])
        roots.append(s3d.at(root, on=frame))
    root = s3d.join(roots[0], *roots[1:])
    return bark_finish(root, seed + 3)

def bark_finish(ob, seed):

    def colour(x, y, z):
        mottling = s3d.noise(x / 115, y / 115, z / 210, seed=seed)
        fine = s3d.noise(x / 27, y / 27, z / 85, seed=seed + 1)
        v = 0.415 + 0.043 * mottling + 0.015 * fine
        return np.stack((v * 0.96, v, v * 1.025), axis=-1)
    s3d.material(ob, 'bark', color=colour, roughness=0.81)
    s3d.smooth(ob, 160)
    return ob

def upright_trunk(seed=23, height=10100, diameter=735):
    with s3d.facets(24, smooth=True):
        path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 220), (40, -25, height * 0.23), (-90, 45, height * 0.48), (75, 100, height * 0.73), (180, 40, height)])
        trunk = s3d.wire('dominant_upright_trunk', path, [(0, diameter), (0.21, diameter * 0.83), (0.48, diameter * 0.58), (0.73, diameter * 0.3), (1, 28)])
        s3d.displace(trunk, 8, 180, seed=seed + 1, step=180)
    return (bark_finish(trunk, seed + 2), path)

def scaffold_branches(trunk_path, seed=37, count=13, reach=4000, rise=1650):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    frames = s3d.along(trunk_path, count=count, spin=137.508, span=(0.21, 0.8)).jitter(rz=19, seed=seed + 1)
    limbs, axes = ([], [])
    for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
        t = i / (count - 1)
        length = reach * (0.78 + 0.22 * np.sin(np.pi * t)) * (1 - 0.48 * t * t) * rng.uniform(0.9, 1.1)
        lift = rise * rng.uniform(0.85, 1.17)
        sway = rng.uniform(-0.18, 0.18) * length
        local_points = [(0, 0, 0), (length * 0.22, sway * 0.2, lift * 0.36), (length * 0.6, sway * 0.8, lift * 0.48), (length, sway, lift)]
        points = [tuple(frame.point(*p)) for p in local_points]
        diameter = 285 * (1 - 0.56 * t) * rng.uniform(0.9, 1.08)
        with s3d.facets(40, smooth=True):
            path = s3d.spline(points)
        with s3d.facets(14, smooth=True):
            limb = s3d.wire('spreading_scaffold', path, [(0, diameter), (0.18, diameter * 0.85), (0.58, diameter * 0.48), (1, 15)])
        limbs.append(bark_finish(limb, seed + 100 + i))
        axes.append((path, diameter))
    return (s3d.group('scaffold_branches', *limbs), axes)

def secondary_branches_and_twigs(axes, seed=53, secondary_count=4, twig_count=4, secondary_length=1160, twig_length=610):
    parts, terminal_paths = ([], [])
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    for i, (axis, diameter) in enumerate(axes):
        frames = s3d.along(axis, count=secondary_count, span=(0.32, 0.94))
        for j, frame in enumerate(frames):
            length = secondary_length * rng.uniform(0.72, 1.2) * (1 - 0.25 * i / len(axes))
            branch, branch_path = offshoot_axis(frame, length, diameter * 0.28 * (1 - 0.12 * j), (-1 if j % 2 else 1) * 73, seed + 100 * i + 7 * j, 'secondary_limb')
            parts.append(branch)
            twig_frames = s3d.along(branch_path, count=twig_count, span=(0.36, 1))
            for k, site in enumerate(twig_frames):
                twig, twig_path = offshoot_axis(site, twig_length * rng.uniform(0.72, 1.22), 15 * rng.uniform(0.75, 1.2), k * 137.508 + j * 43, seed + 10000 + i * 1000 + j * 100 + k * 3, 'terminal_twig')
                parts.append(twig)
                terminal_paths.append(twig_path)
    return (s3d.group('secondary_branches_and_twigs', *parts), terminal_paths)

def offshoot_axis(frame, length, diameter, turn, seed, name):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    origin = np.array(tuple(frame.origin))
    forward = np.array(tuple(frame.point(0, 0, 1))) - origin
    sideways = frame.turn(rz=turn)
    lateral = np.array(tuple(sideways.point(1, 0, 0))) - origin
    direction = 0.66 * forward + 0.73 * lateral + np.array([0, 0, 0.33])
    direction[2] = max(0.14, direction[2])
    direction /= np.linalg.norm(direction)
    drift = np.array([rng.uniform(-0.12, 0.12), rng.uniform(-0.12, 0.12), 0.12]) * length
    points = [origin, origin + direction * length * 0.3, origin + direction * length * 0.7 + drift * 0.35, origin + direction * length + drift]
    with s3d.facets(24 if diameter > 25 else 12, smooth=True):
        path = s3d.spline([tuple(p) for p in points])
    with s3d.facets(10 if diameter > 25 else 6, smooth=True):
        solid = s3d.wire(name, path, [(0, diameter), (0.4, diameter * 0.64), (0.78, diameter * 0.3), (1, max(2.5, diameter * 0.1))])
    return (bark_finish(solid, seed + 1), path)

def evergreen_leaf_clusters(terminal_paths, seed=71, leaves_per_twig=11, length=290, width=125):
    sites = []
    for i, path in enumerate(terminal_paths):
        frames = s3d.along(path, count=leaves_per_twig, spin=137.508, span=(0.36, 1))
        sites.extend(frames.turn(ry=58).jitter(rx=18, ry=19, rz=24, seed=seed + i + 1))
    sites = s3d.Frames(sites)
    scales = s3d.vary(1, 0.24, len(sites), seed=seed + 3000)
    with s3d.facets(6, smooth=True):
        leaf = s3d.loft('leathery_magnolia_blade', s3d.station(0, 3, 2), s3d.station(length * 0.36, width, 7, y=-12), s3d.station(length * 0.73, width * 0.72, 5, y=-7), s3d.station(length, 0, 0, y=5))

    def leaf_colour(x, y, z, n):
        v = 0.93 + 0.07 * np.cos(z / length * np.pi)
        green = np.stack((v * 0.055, v * 0.185, v * 0.094), axis=-1)
        brown = np.stack((v * 0.335, v * 0.159, v * 0.065), axis=-1)
        return np.where((n[1] < 0)[:, None], green, brown)
    s3d.material(leaf, 'leaf', color=leaf_colour, roughness=0.32)
    s3d.smooth(leaf, 170)
    leaves = s3d.at(leaf, on=sites, scale=scales)
    return (s3d.group('evergreen_leaf_clusters', *leaves), sites, scales)

def leaf_midribs(sites, scales, seed=89, length=290, petiole=22, diameter=2.2):
    with s3d.facets(3, smooth=True):
        rib = s3d.loft('raised_midrib_and_petiole', s3d.station(-petiole, diameter, diameter), s3d.station(length * 0.36, diameter * 0.8, diameter * 0.8, y=-16), s3d.station(length * 0.73, diameter * 0.5, diameter * 0.5, y=-10), s3d.station(length * 0.96, 0, 0, y=2))
    s3d.material(rib, 'leaf', color='#536340', roughness=0.51)
    s3d.smooth(rib, 150)
    ribs = s3d.at(rib, on=sites, scale=scales)
    return s3d.merge(*ribs)

def winter_accents(axes, leaf_sites, leaf_scales, seed=107, snow_depth=28):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    rests = []
    for i, (path, diameter) in enumerate(axes):
        if i % 4 == 1:
            continue
        frames = s3d.along(path, count=7, span=(0.1, 0.7))
        points = []
        for k, frame in enumerate(frames):
            u = 0.1 + 0.6 * k / (len(frames) - 1)
            p = np.array(tuple(frame.origin))
            p[2] += diameter * np.interp(u, [0, 0.18, 0.58, 1], [1, 0.85, 0.48, 15 / diameter]) * 0.5 + snow_depth * 0.3
            points.append(tuple(p))
        with s3d.facets(8, smooth=True):
            snowy_path = s3d.spline(points)
            rest = s3d.wire('thin_branch_snow', snowy_path, (diameter * 0.64, snow_depth))
        s3d.material(rest, 'snow', color='#d9e3e6', roughness=0.87)
        rests.append(rest)
    kept, sizes = ([], [])
    for frame, size in zip(leaf_sites, leaf_scales):
        up = frame.point(0, -1, 0).z - frame.origin.z
        if up > 0.35 and rng.random() < 0.075:
            kept.append(frame)
            sizes.append(size)
    if kept:
        with s3d.facets(6, smooth=True):
            patch = s3d.loft('occasional_leaf_snow', s3d.station(65, 0, 0, y=-12), s3d.station(115, 65, 4, y=-18), s3d.station(170, 50, 3, y=-17), s3d.station(210, 0, 0, y=-10))
        s3d.material(patch, 'snow', color='#dbe5e6', roughness=0.92)
        rests.extend(s3d.at(patch, on=s3d.Frames(kept), scale=sizes))
    return s3d.group('winter_accents', *rests)

items.program:
import sand3d as s3d
import numpy as np
import random

def spring_rowan(seed=0):
    mature = compound_leaf(seed=seed + 3, fresh=False)
    young = compound_leaf(seed=seed + 4, fresh=True)
    flowers = flower_corymbs(seed=seed + 5)
    tree = trunk(seed=seed + 1, templates=(mature, young), flowers=flowers)
    roots = spreading_roots(seed=seed + 2)
    s3d.delete(mature)
    s3d.delete(young)
    s3d.delete(flowers)
    return s3d.assembly('spring_rowan', tree, roots)

def compound_leaf(seed=50, fresh=False, length=430, pairs=5, leaflet_l=128, leaflet_w=38, stem_d=1.1):
    with s3d.facets(5, smooth=True):
        path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (0, 6, length * 0.5), (0, 18, length)])
        rachis = s3d.wire('pinnate_rachis', path, [(0, stem_d), (1, stem_d * 0.35)])
    s3d.material(rachis, 'leaf', color='#809843', roughness=0.46)
    sites = s3d.along(path, count=pairs, span=(0.16, 0.84))
    sizes = s3d.vary(1, 0.08, pairs, seed=seed + 1)
    prototype = leaflet(seed=seed + 2, length=leaflet_l, width=leaflet_w, fresh=fresh)
    frames = []
    scales = []
    for i, (f, size) in enumerate(zip(sites, sizes)):
        taper = (1 - 0.26 * i / (pairs - 1)) * size
        frames.extend([f.turn(ry=64, rz=-9), f.turn(ry=-64, rz=9)])
        scales.extend([taper, taper * 0.96])
    frames.append(s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1])
    scales.append(0.85)
    blades = s3d.at(prototype, on=s3d.Frames(frames), scale=scales)
    blades = s3d.merge(*blades)
    return s3d.group('pinnate_leaf', rachis, blades)

def leaflet(seed=60, length=74, width=22, thickness=0.24, fresh=False):
    half = width / 2
    outline = [(0, 0), (-half * 0.72, length * 0.2), (-half, length * 0.38), (-half * 0.78, length * 0.47), (-half * 0.85, length * 0.57), (0, length), (half * 0.85, length * 0.57), (half * 0.78, length * 0.47), (half, length * 0.38), (half * 0.72, length * 0.2)]
    blade = s3d.extrude('pointed_serrate_leaflet', s3d.poly(outline), thickness)
    blade = s3d.bend(blade, 12, axis='+Y', toward='+Z', step=0)
    blade = s3d.at(blade, rx=90)
    s3d.smooth(blade, 65)
    tint = random.Random(seed).uniform(0.94, 1.04)
    green = np.array([0.52, 0.71, 0.25] if fresh else [0.24, 0.45, 0.14]) * tint
    s3d.material(blade, 'leaf', color=lambda x, y, z: (1 - 0.1 * np.clip(y / length, 0, 1))[:, None] * green, roughness=0.3)
    return s3d.group('leaflet', blade)

def flower_corymbs(seed=70, diameter=255, florets=23, stalk_h=160):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    sites = s3d.phyllotaxis(florets, diameter).jitter(z=5, seed=seed + 1)
    stems = []
    flowers = []
    prototype = blossom(seed=seed + 2)
    for f in sites:
        p = f.origin
        z = stalk_h + p.z
        with s3d.facets(5, smooth=True):
            stem = s3d.wire('corymb_pedicel', [(0, 0, 0), (p.x * 0.45, p.y * 0.45, stalk_h * 0.61), (p.x, p.y, z)], 0.7)
        s3d.material(stem, 'leaf', color='#97a66a', roughness=0.65)
        stems.append(stem)
        flowers.append(s3d.at(s3d.copy(prototype), x=p.x, y=p.y, z=z, rx=rng.uniform(-12, 12), ry=rng.uniform(-12, 12), rz=rng.uniform(0, 360)))
    s3d.delete(prototype)
    stems = s3d.merge(*stems)
    with s3d.facets(5, smooth=True):
        packed = s3d.dome('packed_inner_florets', diameter * 0.9, diameter * 0.12)
    packed = s3d.at(packed, z=stalk_h - diameter * 0.13)
    s3d.material(packed, 'ceramic', color='#dedaaf', roughness=0.98)
    return s3d.group('flat_topped_corymb', stems, packed, flowers)

def blossom(seed=80, diameter=38, thickness=1.5):
    sites = s3d.ring(10, diameter / 2, start=random.Random(seed).uniform(0, 72))
    points = [(f.origin.x * (1 if i % 2 == 0 else 0.72), f.origin.y * (1 if i % 2 == 0 else 0.72)) for i, f in enumerate(sites)]
    petals = s3d.extrude('five_creamy_petals', s3d.poly(points), thickness)
    s3d.material(petals, 'ceramic', color='#eee8d0', roughness=0.94)
    with s3d.facets(5, smooth=True):
        centre = s3d.at(s3d.sphere('pale_flower_centre', diameter * 0.23), z=thickness * 0.5, scale=(1, 1, 0.48))
    s3d.material(centre, 'leaf', color='#bba85f', roughness=0.88)
    return s3d.group('tiny_rowan_blossom', petals, centre)

def trunk(seed, templates, flowers, height=6450, base_d=360, limbs=11):
    with s3d.facets(16, smooth=True):
        path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (25, 12, height * 0.26), (-38, 30, height * 0.55), (55, -25, height * 0.8), (25, 0, height)])
        wood = s3d.wire('silver_grey_trunk', path, [(0, base_d), (0.065, base_d * 0.65), (0.4, base_d * 0.43), (0.72, base_d * 0.23), (1, 5)])
    wood = bark_lenticels(wood, seed=seed + 1, raised=True)
    sites = s3d.along(path, count=limbs, spin=137.508, span=(0.32, 0.94)).turn(ry=52)
    boughs = ascending_main_limbs(sites, templates, flowers, seed=seed + 2)
    return s3d.group('trunk_and_crown', wood, boughs)

def bark_lenticels(wood, seed=90, raised=False, mark_count=60, mark_w=38, mark_h=5):

    def colour(x, y, z):
        broad = s3d.noise(x / 110, y / 110, z / 310, seed=seed)
        marks = s3d.noise(x / 12, y / 12, z / 2.1, seed=seed + 1)
        v = 0.035 * broad - 0.18 * np.clip((marks - 0.36) * 4, 0, 1)
        return np.stack((0.47 + v, 0.49 + v, 0.465 + v), axis=-1)
    s3d.material(wood, 'bark', color=colour, roughness=0.61)
    if raised:
        sites = s3d.scatter(mark_count, wood, seed=seed + 2)
        with s3d.facets(6, smooth=True):
            mark = s3d.extrude('subtle_dark_lenticel', s3d.ellipse(mark_w, mark_h), 0.18)
        s3d.material(mark, 'bark', color='#384336', roughness=0.78)
        marks = s3d.at(mark, on=sites)
        return s3d.group('lenticelled_trunk', wood, marks)
    return wood

def ascending_main_limbs(sites, templates, flowers, seed=3, envelope=(1550, 2050, 2200, 2150, 2050, 1900, 1730, 1500, 1250, 1000, 740)):
    factors = s3d.vary(1, 0.1, len(sites), seed=seed + 1)
    boughs = [s3d.at(main_limb(templates, flowers, seed=seed + 100 + i, length=envelope[i] * factors[i]), on=f) for i, f in enumerate(sites)]
    return s3d.group('ascending_main_limbs', boughs)

def main_limb(templates, flowers, seed=10, length=2000, diameter=66, branches=4):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    sway = rng.uniform(-0.08, 0.08) * length
    with s3d.facets(10, smooth=True):
        path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (length * 0.045, sway * 0.3, length * 0.34), (length * 0.1, sway, length * 0.7), (length * 0.15, sway * 0.8, length)])
        limb = s3d.wire('ascending_bough', path, [(0, diameter * length / 2000), (0.4, diameter * 0.64 * length / 2000), (1, 3)])
    bark_lenticels(limb, seed=seed + 1)
    sites = s3d.along(path, count=branches, spin=137.508, span=(0.24, 0.95)).turn(ry=53).jitter(rx=9, ry=10, rz=15, seed=seed + 2)
    lengths = s3d.vary(length * 0.43, length * 0.08, len(sites), seed=seed + 3)
    shoots = [s3d.at(fine_branchlets(templates, flowers, seed=seed + 100 + i, length=l, flowering=i == 1 or i == 3), on=f) for i, (f, l) in enumerate(zip(sites, lengths))]
    return s3d.group('main_limb', limb, shoots)

def fine_branchlets(templates, flowers, seed=20, length=850, diameter=23, forks=2, flowering=False):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    sway = length * rng.uniform(-0.09, 0.09)
    with s3d.facets(7, smooth=True):
        path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (length * 0.055, sway * 0.5, length * 0.42), (length * 0.15, sway, length)])
        wood = s3d.wire('fine_branchlet', path, [(0, diameter), (0.5, diameter * 0.52), (1, 1.5)])
    bark_lenticels(wood, seed=seed + 1)
    sites = s3d.along(path, count=forks, spin=160, span=(0.48, 0.91)).turn(ry=42).jitter(rz=25, ry=8, seed=seed + 2)
    shoots = [s3d.at(leafy_twig(templates, flowers, seed=seed + 30 + i, length=length * 0.53, flowering=flowering and i == 1), on=f) for i, f in enumerate(sites)]
    leaves = pinnate_foliage(path, templates, seed=seed + 3, count=2, span=(0.57, 0.94), scale=1.22)
    return s3d.group('fine_branchlets', wood, shoots, leaves)

def leafy_twig(templates, flowers, seed=30, length=460, flowering=False):
    with s3d.facets(6, smooth=True):
        path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, 0), (length * 0.06, 0, length * 0.48), (length * 0.19, length * 0.05, length)])
        wood = s3d.wire('gently_curved_twig', path, [(0, 8), (0.65, 3), (1, 0.9)])
    s3d.material(wood, 'bark', color='#75785b', roughness=0.62)
    leaves = pinnate_foliage(path, templates, seed=seed + 1, count=3, span=(0.22, 0.91), scale=1.35)
    blossom = []
    if flowering:
        blossom = s3d.at(s3d.copy(flowers), on=s3d.along(path, count=2)[-1], scale=1.3)
    return s3d.group('leafy_twig', wood, leaves, blossom)

def pinnate_foliage(path, templates, seed=40, count=3, span=(0.2, 0.95), scale=1):
    sites = s3d.along(path, count=count, spin=145, span=span).turn(ry=66).jitter(rx=14, ry=12, rz=20, seed=seed + 1)
    sizes = s3d.vary(scale, 0.18, len(sites), seed=seed + 2)
    leaves = s3d.at(s3d.copy(templates[0]), on=s3d.Frames(sites[:-1]), scale=sizes[:-1])
    fresh = s3d.at(s3d.copy(templates[1]), on=sites[-1], scale=sizes[-1])
    return s3d.group('pinnate_foliage', leaves, fresh)

def spreading_roots(seed=2, count=7, radius=920, base_d=290, rise=145):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    roots = []
    sites = s3d.ring(count, 0).jitter(rz=15, seed=seed + 1)
    for i, f in enumerate(sites):
        reach = radius * rng.uniform(0.65, 1.13)
        drift = rng.uniform(-0.18, 0.18) * reach
        with s3d.facets(12, smooth=True):
            path = s3d.spline([(0, 0, rise), (reach * 0.28, drift * 0.3, rise * 0.57), (reach * 0.65, drift, rise * 0.2), (reach, drift, 2)])
            root = s3d.wire('exposed_root', path, [(0, base_d), (0.3, base_d * 0.53), (0.7, base_d * 0.2), (1, 3)])
        bark_lenticels(root, seed=seed + 10 + i)
        roots.append(s3d.at(root, on=f))
    return s3d.group('spreading_roots', roots)
